skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical issues in International Trade Law
Develop skills in research, analysis, and synthesis of issues related to International Trade Law
Identify and solve problems in the field of International Trade Law
Develop the ability to learn independently and accumulate experience to enhance professional expertise in International Trade Law
Enhance the ability to work in a team to solve issues related to International Trade Law
Develop a sense of discipline, responsibility, and cooperation in class and practical settings
Improve the ability to analyze and argue issues and situations in the field of International Trade Law
